Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 4, Verse 42

“Therefore, cutting with the sword of knowledge this doubt in your heart born of ignorance, take refuge in yoga. Arise, Bharata.”

The chapter ends with a weapon in Arjuna's hands, though not the one he expected. And with arise — the same word from Chapter 2, now standing on an argument.
